# telnyx_10dlc_brand_2fa_email (Action)

Resends the two-factor authentication email for a 10DLC brand. The brand contact completes verification through the link in the email before registration continues.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `brand_id` (String) The brand id.
